page_title: VER 0-0 PAR | Verona v Parma 31/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' That was close! Casper Tengstedt (Verona) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
90+5' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+4' The ball is laid off to Drissa Camara (Parma) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Lorenzo Montipo to make a decent save.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Milan Djuric (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Simon Sohm.
90+1' Good clearance! Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' A rebound bounces out to Emanuele Valeri (Parma) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
88' Here's the change. Dennis Man leaves the pitch and Drissa Camara (Parma) comes on as a substitute.
88' Christian Chivu has decided to make a change. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replaces Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
88' Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Parma keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Parma.
87' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
85' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
83' Here is a change. Domagoj Bradaric is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Oyegoke (Verona).
83' A substitution has been made. Amin Sarr is replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
82' Parma get a corner.

82' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Parma win a corner.
81' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
78' Parma will take a corner kick.

78' Parma play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
77' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ondrej Duda (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
75' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma).
71' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
71' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
69' The game has come to an end for Pawel Dawidowicz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Suat Serdar (Verona).
69' Christian Chivu prepares a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny is replaced by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma).
69' That's the end of the game for Pontus Almqvist, who is replaced by Jacob Ondrejka (Parma).
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Ondrej Duda (Verona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.
62' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Casper Tengstedt (Verona) for Daniel Mosquera.
58' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) replacing Antoine Bernede.
58' Dennis Man (Parma) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
55' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
51' Verona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' An attempted cross from Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

48' Mandela Keita (Parma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' A neat pass is well received by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
42' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' A pass by Ondrej Duda (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
41' Now Verona have a corner.
40' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
39' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Domagoj Bradaric, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

37' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Lorenzo Montipo to get hold of the ball.
36' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
35' Amin Sarr (Verona) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
34' The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.
34' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
30' The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Parma as they win a corner.
29' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
27' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Verona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
26' Ondrej Duda (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.

25' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Verona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
24' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
23' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
21' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
20' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
19' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Simon Sohm (Parma) picks up a long through ball, but Lorenzo Montipo deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
17' A long pass finds Daniel Mosquera (Verona) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
16' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
16' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
13' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Pontus Almqvist (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
12' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
10' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
8' Amin Sarr (Verona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Juan Luca Sacchi blows the whistle, Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is penalised for a foul.
6' A pass from Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo and the move breaks down.
5' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a long ball in, but Zion Suzuki comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simon Sohm (Parma).
2' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Verona.
1' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Verona.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Luca Sacchi.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
